summary: List published FAQs for a page
description: Website FAQ list for one page (legacy `/api/faqs?page=` contract; `id` is the FAQ uid). `route` is required (`page` is accepted as its legacy alias); missing → 400 `validation_error`, unknown route → 404 `page_not_found` (the page is resolved whatever its status). Only PUBLISHED FAQs, ordered by section, `sort_order`; at most 200 rows. `section` filters exactly when present (empty selects the unnamed section); `category` is a category **slug**. `meta.schema` is the FAQPage JSON-LD of the returned rows (null when none). Values are matched exactly (not trimmed).

auth.notes: Anonymous. Throttle `public_read` (600/min per client IP). Version-keyed server cache 300 s (namespaces `faqs`, `sitepages`); response headers `ETag`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=60`, `X-Cache: HIT|MISS`; `If-None-Match` → 304.

headers.description: Optional: an ETag from a previous response; a match returns 304 Not Modified.

query_params.description: Site path of the page, e.g. `/subsidy` (required unless `page` is given).

Capped at the slot's `max_length` and checked against its `kind` (SHORT_TEXT single line, URL http(s) or `/path`, EMAIL, PHONE): 400 `validation_error`. `expected_version` is the **slot's** `version` → 409 `stale_version`. Unknown key → 404 `slot_not_found`. Seeded keys (career page): `hero_title` (SHORT_TEXT, max 90), `hero_subtitle` (LONG_TEXT, max 220).

auth.scope: Module has only the `all` scope (no record-scope filter registered).

path_params.name: uid
path_params.description: Uid of a page that has slots. Only the career page (`/career`, slug `career`) declares slots in the registry (`sitepages.services.registry.SLOTS`), so this request uses `{{career_page_uid}}`; any other page answers 404 `slot_not_found`.

path_params.description: Text slot key (`^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`). Seeded: `hero_title`, `hero_subtitle` (career page only). Captured from Retrieve career page (`text_slots.0.key`).
